blocks.text: Interphase mein chromatin dugna hota hai: DNA replicate hota aur naye histones bante hain. Is ke baad har chromosome do aik jaise strands, sister chromatids, ka hota hai jo aik tang hisse, centromere, par jure hote hain. Kitab centromere ko taqreeban 220 nucleotides ka khaas DNA silsila batati hai. Centromere se disc jaisa protein dhaancha, kinetochore, jura hota hai; taqseem ke dauran chromosome yahin se spindle se jurta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: duplicate shuda chromosome, do sister chromatids jo centromere par kinetochore disc ke saath jure hain; oopar secondary constriction aik chhoti gaanth, satellite, ko alag karti hai; siron par telomeres. Daen: chaar chromosomes jin mein centromere beech mein (metacentric), thora hat kar (sub-metacentric), aik sire ke qareeb (acrocentric) aur bilkul sire par (telocentric).
blocks.caption: Duplicate shuda chromosome aur centromere ki jagah ke lehaaz se chaar qismein (Figures 19.1 aur 19.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Interphase mein DNA replication ke baad har chromosome do aik jaise sister chromatids ka hota hai jo aik tang hisse, centromere, par jure hote hain; centromere DNA ka khaas silsila hai jis se disc jaisa protein, kinetochore, juda hota hai, aur taqseem ke dauran spindle fibres kinetochore se jurte hain. Kuch chromosomes mein secondary constriction, yaani nucleolar organizer region, hoti hai jo interphase mein nucleoli banati hai, aur is ke parre gaanth jaisa sira satellite hai. Sire telomeres hain jo chromosomes ko siron se aapas mein chipakne nahi dete. Centromere ki jagah ke hisaab se chromosomes metacentric, sub-metacentric, acrocentric ya telocentric hain.

items: Secondary constriction (nucleolar organizer region, NOR): kuch chromosomes mein doosri tangi jo interphase mein nucleoli banati hai.
Satellite: secondary constriction se parre chromosome ka gaanth jaisa sira; kitab ke mutabiq is hisse mein bohat dohraye jane wale DNA silsile hain jinhein junk DNA kehte hain.
Telomeres: chromosomes ke aakhri sire jo do chromosomes ko siron se aapas mein jurne nahi dete.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Chromosomes German mahir-e-janeeniyat Walther Flemming ne 1882 mein salamander ke larvae ke tezi se taqseem hote cells mein daryaft kiye. Naam 'chromosome', lafzi maani 'rangeen ajsaam', German mahir-e-tashreeh Waldeyer-Hartz ne 1888 mein tajweez kiya.

blocks.prompt: Spindle fibres chromosome se kahan jurte hain, aur telomeres kya karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Kinetochore par, jo centromere par protein disc hai. Siron par telomeres chromosomes ko siron se aapas mein jurne nahi dete.

items: Duplicate chromosome: centromere par jure do sister chromatids; kinetochore spindle fibres pakarta.
NOR nucleoli banata; us se parre satellite; siron par telomeres.
